## Highlights

Zova 1.0.0-rc.2 refines native execution and packaging while preserving the
candidate 1.x public contract and storage format 11.

This is a prerelease. Validate applications and migrations before Zova 1.0.0;
correctness and compatibility fixes may still require another candidate.

## What's changed

- Avoided unused chunk-counting work when putting an existing object.
- Reused connection-owned statements for single-call KV operations.
- Removed repeated front-shifting when draining bounded notification queues.
- Carried private integer node keys through graph traversal instead of repeated
  public-ID resolution.
- Prepared exact floating-point vector query values once per query and expanded
  the retained benchmark diagnostics for short-query latency.
- Split CLI, database, and C ABI internals into focused modules while preserving
  public entry points, ownership, ordering, and error behavior.
- Extracted public-only database and C ABI behavior tests without removing
  white-box or subsystem coverage from the complete Zig test gate.
- Added Python 3.13 and 3.14 wheel coverage using `cp313-abi3` artifacts. Python
  source distributions are no longer published; supported installations use
  prebuilt wheels rather than requiring a local native build toolchain.

## Candidate 1.x contract

- Numeric C ABI components remain `1.0.0`; the complete package and ABI identity
  is `1.0.0-rc.2`.
- Advanced opaque-key graph, payload, topology-scan, and fresh-build APIs remain
  low-level C ABI/raw `zova-sys` surfaces, not high-level binding additions.
- Experimental extension authoring remains outside the stable 1.x contract.

## Storage compatibility

- Storage format remains 11; rc.1 format-11 databases need no migration.
- Formats 9 and 10 retain explicit copy-forward migration to format 11.
- Opening does not migrate silently. Migration leaves the source unchanged.
- Formats older than 9 and downgrades remain unsupported.

## Prerelease installation

- GitHub marks this release as a prerelease.
- npm publishes `zova-js` and native companion packages under `next`, without
  moving stable `latest`.
- Python uses distribution version `1.0.0rc2` and requires Python 3.13 or newer;
  release validation covers standard CPython 3.13 and 3.14.
- Cargo and Go use `1.0.0-rc.2`.

## Known boundaries

Browser/WASM support is deferred to rc.3 and is not included. Existing platform,
extension-authoring, notification, and high-level binding boundaries still
apply; this release does not add new compatibility claims for other runtimes.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ata-sesli/zova/compare/v1.0.0-rc.1...v1.0.0-rc.2
